purpose: Every reason in docs/self-improvement/tree.json (the plugin's five-whys run on its own 6/10 rating) receives exactly one disposition code from this catalog, recorded in ledger.json.
facts: A full real run completed on 2026-09-13: 26 agents, about 1.2M subagent tokens, about 7 minutes, 3,905 reasons, 1 exact-duplicate text, 511 KB / about 128k tokens output.
The plugin is a git repository published publicly at github.com/JoshuaRamirez/five-whys and listed in the RedJay marketplace.
The run hit Claude Code's default 20-concurrent-subagent cap; the skill now dispatches at most 20 per round (committed fix).
plan already skips fragments that exist and validate, so interrupted runs resume by re-running plan; run.json stores the problem statement and creation time.
check takes --depth; breadth is the module constant BRANCHING; the shape is otherwise hard-coded as 5 wide by 5 deep with a root/branch split at level 2.
The agent definition uses model: inherit, lists eight generic cause kinds, tells agents to assume typical context, and requires one Write of the whole fragment.
There are no tests, no evals, no cost preview, no hygiene/duplicate checks, and no navigation subcommand in v0.1.0.
The user's requirements: 5x5x5x5x5 reasons; everything goes into one JSON for whole-context reading; analysis is up to the user of the plugin.
All 28 NEW entries from the classification pass were reconciled on 2026-09-13 into IMP-20..IMP-31 (accepted) or R-08..R-10 and existing codes.

improvements.title: Parameterized shape
improvements.detail: init --breadth/--depth (defaults 5/5); root/branch split derived; shape stored in run.json; plan, check, assemble, prompts and examples all read it instead of literals.

improvements.title: Smoke preset and subset dispatch
improvements.detail: init --preset smoke (3 wide x 3 deep) for cheap rehearsal; plan --only <id,...> to dispatch chosen branches.

improvements.title: Dispatch waves
improvements.detail: plan groups tasks into waves no larger than the concurrency cap (default 20); the skill dispatches wave by wave.

improvements.title: Model selection
improvements.detail: init --model (inherit|sonnet|opus|haiku) recorded in run.json; plan emits it per task; the skill passes it as the Agent model override; docs explain the trade-off.

improvements.title: Cost and size preview with confirmation
improvements.detail: init and plan report agent count, reason count and measured token estimates; the skill confirms with the user before dispatching a full-size run.

improvements.title: Non-blocking hygiene report
improvements.detail: assemble writes hygiene.json: exact duplicates, near-duplicates (stdlib token overlap discounting ancestor words), children restating a parent or ancestor, over-length reasons. Flags annotate only; nothing is deleted, ranked or summarized.

improvements.title: Sibling-aware branch prompts
improvements.detail: Branch prompts include the other level-1/level-2 reasons as causes covered elsewhere, so isolated agents avoid reproducing them.

improvements.title: Agent instructions for specificity
improvements.detail: Replace the fixed generic cause-kind checklist and 'assume typical context' with grounding in the problem's specifics, explicit stated assumptions, outline-before-write, a specific-vs-generic example, targeted Edit repairs, and a fix-loop cap.

improvements.title: Navigation and partial reading
improvements.detail: show subcommand prints a subtree with its ancestor chain or the top N levels; assemble writes index.md of levels 1-2; loading guidance pages branch by branch.

improvements.title: Measurement recorded in output
improvements.detail: Assembled header and run.json record per-level counts, average words per level, bytes, approximate tokens, created-to-assembled duration and dispatch attempts.

improvements.title: Test suite
improvements.detail: stdlib unittest coverage for shapes, init, plan, check, assemble, hygiene, show, waves and partial assembly.

improvements.title: Failure semantics
improvements.detail: Dispatch attempts recorded per task; tasks past 3 attempts reported as stuck; agents cap their fix loop and reply FAILED with the first error.

improvements.title: Progress status
improvements.detail: status subcommand prints done/total fragments and missing ids; the skill reports progress after each wave.

improvements.title: Honest documentation
improvements.detail: README documents measured cost and time, what validation does and does not cover, known limitations, the concurrency cap, a real excerpt, and design decisions (stdlib-only, generation-only).

improvements.title: Principle clarification
improvements.detail: Skill, agent and README separate allowed mechanical aids (hygiene flags, navigation, measurement) from interpretation, ranking, pruning and summarizing, which stay with the user.

improvements.title: Optional context intake
improvements.detail: The skill accepts extra context and, when the problem statement is thin, asks once for key specifics; context is stored in run.json and included in every prompt.

improvements.title: Self-improvement record
improvements.detail: Keep this tree, catalog and the 3,905-entry ledger in docs/self-improvement as dogfooding evidence and a changelog of why each change was made.

improvements.title: Eval suite
improvements.detail: evals/ case for claude plugin eval that exercises a smoke-preset run end to end and grades shape validity and hygiene report presence.

improvements.title: Partial assembly
improvements.detail: assemble --partial writes a valid tree with explicit missing-branch markers so interrupted or budget-capped runs still yield output.

improvements.title: Runs kept out of git
improvements.detail: init writes .five-whys/.gitignore because problem statements and reasons can be sensitive.

improvements.title: Release checklist
improvements.detail: RELEASING.md gates version bumps on unit tests, manifest validation and a real smoke run.

improvements.title: Skill option syntax
improvements.detail: Leading --smoke, --model, --breadth, --depth, --yes and --resume flags in the invocation, advertised in argument-hint.

improvements.title: Fragment hygiene warnings in check
improvements.detail: check prints non-blocking warnings (repeated text, restatements, over-long reasons) after OK.

improvements.title: Compact dispatch
improvements.detail: plan writes full prompts to files; the dispatch prompt is a short pointer, keeping the orchestrator's context small.

improvements.title: Evidence reading
improvements.detail: Agents Read local files or paths named in the problem or context before writing reasons.

improvements.title: Random spot-check sampling
improvements.detail: show --sample N --seed S prints random reasons with their ancestor chains.

improvements.title: Size hint in prompts
improvements.detail: Prompts state expected output tokens so agents don't compress reasons to save room.

improvements.title: Separate root and branch models
improvements.detail: init --root-model and --branch-model (default: --model) let root and branch tasks use different tiers.

improvements.title: Docs consistency test
improvements.detail: unittest keeps README, skill and agent text consistent with script defaults and options.

improvements.title: CI for unit tests
improvements.detail: GitHub Actions runs the stdlib unittest suite on push and pull request; no model calls.

improvements.title: Check log
improvements.detail: check appends each result to the run's check-log.jsonl; status reports check cycles per fragment.

dispositions.title: Declined: plugin-side ranking, synthesis, pruning or root-cause selection
dispositions.detail: The user's requirement puts analysis with the user. Mechanical hygiene flags (IMP-06) are the allowed substitute.

dispositions.title: Declined: embeddings, third-party packages, API keys or network calls in the script
dispositions.detail: Would break the zero-dependency offline install. Stdlib heuristics (IMP-06) instead.

dispositions.title: Declined: LLM judge inside the blocking fix loop
dispositions.detail: Flaky verdicts cause endless loops and multiply cost. Non-blocking hygiene flags instead.

dispositions.title: Declined: dropping complete trees (adaptive fan-out, early stopping, variable depth, 'not applicable' slots)
dispositions.detail: The user specified complete 5x5x5x5x5 trees. The shape is configurable (IMP-01) but every tree stays complete.

dispositions.title: Declined: heavy infrastructure
dispositions.detail: MCP server, database store, HTML viewer, CI with live model runs, telemetry backend, prompt-cache engineering. File-based tools (IMP-09/10/11/18) cover the need.

dispositions.title: Out of scope: social or organizational remedies
dispositions.detail: Recruiting reviewers, beta testers or experts, user research, building public benchmark datasets. Not changes to the plugin.

dispositions.title: Declined: sequential waves that feed deeper generated output between branches, shared scratchpads
dispositions.detail: Serializes the run. IMP-07 shares the cheap level-1/2 digest instead.

dispositions.title: Declined: plain-text outline fragments converted by the script
dispositions.detail: All 26 JSON fragments in the real run passed their first check; JSON keeps validation exact and simple.

dispositions.title: Declined: dropping the per-line depth key or indentation
dispositions.detail: They keep lines self-describing when the file is read in windows; the saving is small.

dispositions.title: Deferred: empirical studies
dispositions.detail: Model-tier quality and full-tree versus single-branch loading comparisons are recorded as known limitations, not code changes.

dispositions.title: Already resolved in the current state
dispositions.detail: The note must say what resolved it (see facts).

dispositions.title: Premise is factually wrong about the current plugin
dispositions.detail: The note must say what is actually true.

dispositions.title: Outside the plugin's control
dispositions.detail: A fact about Claude Code, models, the ecosystem or industry culture that no plugin change can address.

dispositions.title: Past motivation, process or psychology with no further artifact change
dispositions.detail: Plausible explanation of how v0.1.0 came to be; any actionable part is already covered by another code.

dispositions.title: Actionable improvement missing from this catalog
dispositions.detail: The note must state the proposed change; the lead reconciles every NEW entry into an IMP, R or X code before merge.
